statusText: EA_ON / green: NQ remains closed; Tail is low while geopolitical, inflation and policy uncertainty keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the Sunday Globex reopening is the principal structural checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress before NQ reopening
body: NQ is closed until the Sunday Globex session. U.S.-China talks remain underway with no verified outcome at the cutoff; Kashkari's inflation remarks and Iran/Houthi escalation raise reopening uncertainty. Without live NQ price-path evidence, persistent mean-reversion failure is not observed.

forecast.analysis: If the first post-open hour shows repeated extension with weak retracements, WATCH can persist; a meaningful pullback would weaken the Tail case.
If two-way discovery develops by the second post-open hour, Tail should ease within WATCH; failed pullbacks or extreme holding would keep the danger window active.
If the reopening gap is meaningfully retraced and cross-assets stabilize, the base case returns below WATCH; one-way extension would invalidate that normalization.
If overnight trading remains two-way, Tail should ease while Stress stays extreme because geopolitical, inflation and policy risks remain unresolved.

forecast.analysis: If no delayed second leg emerges, Tail should remain below WATCH; renewed extension after a failed pullback is the main re-escalation trigger.
If rotation replaces directional extension, Tail should stay low as the reopening shock decays, while headline-driven Stress remains extreme.
If price discovery stays orderly into Europe, low Tail remains the base case; a fresh energy or security shock would mainly raise Stress unless price aligns.
If overnight retracements remain meaningful, mean-reversion failure should stay unconfirmed despite the elevated rates and geopolitical backdrop.
If European participation does not reinforce one direction, Tail should stay low; directional breadth plus shallow pullbacks would be the contrary signal.
If Europe brings cross-asset divergence rather than alignment, Stress can remain extreme while Tail stays low.
If Europe develops directional efficiency with shallow retracements, conditional Tail rises modestly; otherwise two-way structure keeps it low.
A scheduled Goolsbee appearance at 10:30 UTC is a policy checkpoint. Tail should stay low unless any repricing aligns with persistent NQ direction and weak retracements.
If no new catalyst aligns with persistent direction, Tail should stay low as U.S. premarket liquidity improves; Stress remains extreme.
CFNAI at 12:30 UTC adds a data checkpoint before cash open; Tail stays below WATCH unless the release coincides with directional NQ efficiency and weak retracements.
drivers: Chicago Fed National Activity Index at 12:30 UTC

forecast.analysis: If pre-open NQ remains balanced, Tail should stay below WATCH into the cash open; shallow opening pullbacks plus repeated extension would raise Tail.
If the first cash-session hour develops two-way auction and meaningful pullbacks, Tail should stay low; persistent opening continuation would be the adverse structure.
If the second cash-session hour remains rotational, Tail should stay low; continued one-way extension after failed pullbacks would be the principal adverse signal.
If the U.S. midday session remains rotational with meaningful retracements, Tail should stay low; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the contrary signal.
If midday liquidity remains two-way and cross-assets do not align directionally, Tail should ease modestly while geopolitical and rate-sensitive Stress remains high.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is closed; current headline and policy risks lift Stress, but no live mean-reversion failure is observable.
Reopening proximity raises gap risk, while one-way structure remains unobserved.
Policy and geopolitical sensitivity keep Stress extreme two hours before price discovery resumes.
The final pre-open hour remains a headline-sensitive checkpoint; Tail stays below WATCH absent new evidence.
At reopening, WATCH is conditional on a large aligned gap plus shallow or failed retracements.
WATCH can persist only if the first post-open hour shows repeated extension and weak retracements.
